figures.title: real93 LoRA training and text-to-image synthesis (arm D)
figures.notes: Sources: docs/v5_prompts/qwen21_lora_training_validation.md, full_generation_20261004.md, pilot_workflow_api.json. Actual compatible training: Qwen-Image-2.1 DiffSynth-Studio SFT DiT LoRA, rank16, LR1e-4, repeat5, epochs4, batch1, 1860 optimizer steps, max_pixels1048576, FlowMatchSFTLoss, AdamW / ConstantLR. 93 reviewed image-caption pairs; no held-out LoRA validation set. Earlier Liblib 2000-step/0.0004 LoRA is incompatible and is not the formal D weight. Inference: qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors, qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors, qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors, step-1860.safetensors at0.8, random seeds, 1184x896, Euler/simple25steps CFG1 denoise1 empty negative, batch1. 1308 candidates (558+750) completed 2026-10-04. Screening/labels pending, target465+620=1085. Displayed D pictures are unscreened candidates, not evidence of downstream benefit.
